research.source_rule: Official primary sources only. Recheck fees and eligibility before activation.

recommended_primary.product: Invoicing Starter with hosted card and US bank payment methods
recommended_primary.reason: Private hosted invoice, no cart, card/ACH, refunds, and payout to an owner-private bank destination.
owner_private_steps: choose legal payee and entity type
complete identity, tax, website/product, support, and statement-descriptor onboarding
add payout bank only inside Stripe
issue a live invoice only after a real buyer and signed scope exist

fallback.reason: Official invoices, card/ACH, deposit requests, and milestone/payment schedules. Confirm exact US onboarding fields in the owner UI.

escrow_option.use_when: Buyer accepts Upwork account creation, platform fees, escrow review/hold timing, and identity verification.
escrow_option.not_primary_reason: More friction and delay than a private hosted invoice.

public_template_fields: service package name and public price
never_public: SSN, ITIN, EIN, TIN, W-9 contents, tax returns
date of birth, government ID, selfie or liveness material
home or legal address when private
bank routing/account, IBAN, SWIFT, voided check, bank statement
card number, expiry, CVC, bank login, financial tokens
buyer PII, private contract, questionnaire, customer code or model bytes

preconditions: legal payee/entity and tax identity exist and match
processor KYC is activated for live charges
hosted invoice or funded milestone exists
why_not_reached: owner legal payee/entity/tax fields are not known in this public work
processor account is not measured active
